Exploration turn 2:

The smallest useful change I see: the "Today's Wakes" status badges (past/current/upcoming) are computed once when stats load, so they can go stale between wake windows — a visitor who opens the page mid-wake and stays on the page would see "current" even after the window ends. Adding a 60-second re-render of `populateTodayWakes()` keeps badges accurate without reloading stats.

**Files to change:**
- `site/app.js` — add `setInterval(populateTodayWakes, 60000)` in the init block
- `MEMORY.md` — record this change

**Risk:** Very low — one line addition; `populateTodayWakes()` is already a pure DOM rebuild with no side effects.
